# Digli

> Digli is a vinyl companion app for iPhone. Scan album covers or barcodes, build your collection, and get recommendations based on what you already own — not what’s trending.

Digli helps record collectors know their shelf and decide what to hunt, buy, and play next. It runs on iPhone. The web app entry point is https://app.digli.ca. The marketing site is https://digli.ca.

## Product facts

- Platform: iPhone (iOS)
- Free tier: 10 free scans, no credit card required
- Digli Pro: $3.99 USD / month via Apple In-App Purchase
- Website: https://digli.ca
- App: https://app.digli.ca
- Support: https://digli.ca/support.html
- Privacy: https://digli.ca/privacy.html
- Terms: https://digli.ca/terms.html

## What Digli does

1. Scan a record cover or barcode → Digli identifies the release and adds it to the Dig Pile
2. File keepers to Your Shelf (owned) or Want List (still hunting)
3. Digli learns how you collect and surfaces fit, hunt, and play suggestions

## Core features

- Dig Profile: a collector portrait built from Your Shelf (personality, insights, taste tags)
- Collection Match: scores how a record fits what you already own, with reasons
- Worth the Hunt: personalized suggestions for records to look for next
- Discogs import: bring an existing Discogs collection onto Your Shelf (one free import; Pro keeps sync)
- Dig Pile: inbox for every scan before filing
- Your Shelf: owned records, browsable by genre
- Want List: records you’re still hunting
- Today’s Spin: one record from your shelf to play today
- Match My Mood: pick a feeling; Digli picks a record from your shelf
- 30-second track previews: hear a track before you decide

## Pricing

- Free: 10 scans to start; cover/barcode scan; Dig Pile, Shelf, Want List; one Discogs import; no card
- Digli Pro ($3.99/month): unlimited scans; full Dig Profile; Collection Match and Same Orbit; Worth the Hunt and Match My Mood; Today’s Spin, Liner Notes, Discogs sync
- Manage, cancel, or restore Digli Pro through Apple ID subscriptions

## Who it’s for

Vinyl collectors who shop in record stores, catalog what they own, and want recommendations rooted in their shelf — crate diggers, completists, and everyday collectors.

## How to get help

Use Account → Feedback inside the Digli iPhone app. Billing and cancellations are handled by Apple.
